title: tailwind-dictionary config
description: Config for tailwind-dictionary: design tokens → Tailwind CSS theme (v3 and v4). https://prosazhin.dev/docs/tailwind-dictionary

source.description: Globs or file paths of design token files (legacy "value" or DTCG "$value"). Default is ["tokens/**/*.json"].

output.description: Folder for the result: <output>/tailwind/theme.css (and theme.js for v3). Default is "./styles".

themeAliases.description: Tailwind theme key → token path separated by "/" (e.g. "font/family"). "extend" holds aliases for theme.extend (v3).

themes.description: Theme token files. Each key except "default" and "prefix" is a theme name: "light", "dark", "high-contrast", …

default.description: Theme whose values go to :root. Default is "light" (base tokens if there are no light files).

prefix.description: Prefix of semantic CSS variables in v4: --<prefix>-<key>-<name>. Default is "theme".

additionalProperties.description: Globs or file paths of the theme token files.
